description: Check a driver qualification file: application, pre-employment MVR and safety performance history within 30 days of hire, road test or equivalent, annual MVR and review, medical certificate, CDLIS medical status or National Registry note, Clearinghouse queries. Says what is missing, late, expiring or overdue, whether the driver is qualified to drive today, and retention dates. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
